answer: Fingerprint Overlap Scoring flags clusters whose interaction graphs overlap too cleanly. Each identity’s counterparties are hashed into a ferrous-backed ledger, then pairwise overlap is compared against a null model; a knoll of near-identical neighborhoods triggers review. Enforcement voids rewards retroactively and quarantines the cluster. An attacker must spend real per-identity effort building distinct, juniper-diverse histories, making each fake cost roughly a full genuine user’s operating budget.
